passed.title: Validation passed
passed.description: The application completed all required validation checks.

rejected.title: Application rejected
rejected.description: The agents completed their review and found validation issues.

processingFailed.title: Processing failed
processingFailed.description: The agent workflow stopped before a final decision was produced.

pending.title: Waiting to start
pending.description: The application is queued for agent processing.

processing.title: Processing application
processing.description: The agents are reviewing the application and its documents.

retrying.title: Temporary interruption
retrying.description: The workflow is retrying an agent request automatically.

unknown.title: Application status
unknown.description: Review the available application and processing information below.

notifications.retryFallback: The application could not be retried.

failure.label: What happened

provider_quota.title: watsonx.ai quota or service association issue
provider_quota.description: The documents were uploaded, but the document processing Agent was refused when it called the model.
provider_quota.clarification: Validation did not start. This is not a rejected loan or a document-content error.

provider_authorization.title: The external AI service refused access
provider_authorization.description: The Agent started, but the current service credentials or permissions could not complete the model request.

provider_rate_limit.title: The external AI service is temporarily busy
provider_rate_limit.description: The model service is limiting request volume, so this run did not complete.

provider_unavailable.title: The external AI service is temporarily unavailable
provider_unavailable.description: The Agent started, but the model service did not return a successful response.

document_mismatch.title: Agent returned a different document filename
document_mismatch.description: The document processing Agent returned a filename different from the requested document, so processing stopped before a loan decision. This is not a rejected loan.

timeout.title: The Agent response timed out
timeout.description: Processing started, but a complete response did not arrive within the allowed time.

unknown.title: Agent processing did not complete
unknown.description: Technical records are available, but the system cannot safely identify a more specific cause.

actions.check_service_configuration: Ask an administrator to check the watsonx.ai Runtime or WML instance association, project permissions, and available quota.
actions.retry_later: Try again later. If the issue continues, give the problem code and Trace ID to an administrator.
actions.review_technical_details: Open the technical details below and give the problem code and Trace ID to an administrator.
actions.check_agent_document_mapping: Ask an administrator to compare the filename returned by the Agent with the requested document and review the technical record below.

failure.retryAfterFix: Retrying will fail again until the service configuration or quota is fixed.
failure.retryAfterDocumentFix: Retrying may fail again until the document mapping issue is understood.

processing.heading: Agent processing
processing.description: Three agents review the documents and produce the final result.
processing.emptyDescription: The agent timeline will appear here after processing begins.

documentProcessing.name: Document processing
documentProcessing.description: Classifies each document and extracts the application fields.

documentValidation.name: Document validation
documentValidation.description: Checks authenticity, completeness, expiry, and document risk.

finalDecision.name: Final decision
finalDecision.description: Cross-checks the application and returns the validation result.
